posts.title: The related employer controlled group
posts.description: Disclaimer: Not an accountant nor a lawyer. For employees in the US, employers (not just the employee) can contribute to the employee’s retirement fund 401(k). There is an maximum limit. It is M = \$61,000 for 2022. If a person works for multiple unrelated employers, each employer, in theory, can contribute M to their 401(k).
